jobs.purpose: PIX research companion: hero portrait on Ask PIX and the PIX station in the home observatory (replacing the procedural placeholder).

preview.prompt: Original compact floating research robot companion for a microgravity combustion science observatory. Rounded hard-surface capsule head with a wide dark glass visor showing two soft cyan optical sensors, a short antenna topped by a small amber flame-shaped light, slim floating torso with a thin hover ring underneath, no legs, two tiny folded manipulator fins. Premium stylized semi-realistic hard-surface design, navy and charcoal shell panels, subtle ivory seams, restrained amber accent lights, scientific cyan details. Clean readable silhouette, centered, single object, no base, no floor, no text, no logos, no insignia.

refine.texture_prompt: navy and charcoal painted metal shell with fine panel seams, satin ivory trim, dark glossy glass visor, emissive cyan sensor eyes, small amber light on the antenna tip, subtle realistic wear, physically based materials
